meta.description: Release Intel 'playlist' mission executor. Acks the dispatch immediately with an execution id (read by mission-dispatcher.service.ts), then discovers editorial/curator playlist opportunities once SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and a curator-contact source are connected, and posts results to POST /api/release-intel/missions/:missionId/callback. Requires n8n env vars DATIAM_API_URL and DATIAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET (must equal the backend's N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET).
